rows.corpus_definition: To separate something into two or more parts.
rows.example_en: Can we divide the cake into four pieces?

rows.corpus_definition: the legal ending of a marriage
rows.example_en: Their divorce was finalised last spring.

rows.corpus_definition: No longer married to the person you were once wed to.
rows.example_en: My parents are divorced but remain friends.

rows.corpus_definition: Feeling like the world is spinning around you.
rows.example_en: The heat made me feel quite dizzy.

rows.corpus_definition: to fasten clothes or a bag using buttons or zippers.
rows.example_en: Please do up your coat before going outside.

rows.corpus_definition: To pull something along the ground with effort.
rows.example_en: He tried to drag the heavy bag inside.

rows.corpus_definition: to cause liquid to flow away; to use up energy or resources
rows.example_en: Remember to drain the pasta before serving.

rows.corpus_definition: a person or creature much smaller than normal size
rows.example_en: The fantasy story featured a brave dwarf warrior.

rows.corpus_definition: a substance used to change the colour of hair, cloth, or food
rows.example_en: She used blue dye to colour her hair.

rows.corpus_definition: a series of rulers from the same family over many years
rows.example_en: The Ming dynasty ruled China for nearly 300 years.
